notes.title: DUELING DAMSELS WAIFU PASS
notes.content:

[i]Starting with this Tournament Pass, we are adding a lot of QoL updates to Waifu Shop: [/i][/p][list][*][p]We removed some annoying notifications, especially for starting players[/p][/*][*][p]The Restock option will show you a new set of Blueprints and Waifus in Orb of Fortune[/p][/*][*][p]Merchant subscription owners have extra rewards in the free Waifu Pass track[/p][/*][*][p]Daily tasks have been replaced by permanent Daily and Weekly tasks. She's setting up her own spot just outside.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We hope your daily game time feels more consistent and rewarding with these changes!
[/p][p]CRAFT. TRADE. LOVE.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549806/2e3afceea23eb5db44eb6678ed683a23bf3d62de.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Waifu Shop Roadmap
notes.content:
[p]Merry meet, my good Master Trader![/p][p]We are now two months into Waifu Shop on Steam! Being in good company with all of you, we can talk with more ease about the future of the game.[/p][p]Just recently, we pondered [url="https://tendertroupe.com/waifu-shop-roadmap/"]our original Roadmap for Waifu Shop[/url]. We published it shortly after the game first launched, and sighed in relief that most of it came true in a timely manner. It’s no secret that, upon release, Waifu Shop was “due” rather than “done”. We put in a lot of effort to work on new features while managing a live game, and [url="https://discord.gg/ugHkRpaFPt"]your live Discord feedback[/url] was a real blessing that kept us on a good path. By its Steam launch, Waifu Shop was a much more engaging game, closer to our original vision.[/p][p]But we’re not done here.[/p][p]Put on your Covered Helmets and let’s take a stroll around the construction site. Here are some of the changes you can expect to see in your game this year.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549806/e172950f186e0fd098b751042ef54a86212aaab0.jpg"][/img][i]A quick look at Tier 8 items[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Any moment now:[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Wheel of Fortune [/b]because what kind of live game doesn’t have a Wheel of Fortune. This’ll likely be part of our next update.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Achievements[/b]. You’re gonna feel a real dopamine rush as your Steam Client pings all your friends about what a Waifu Wrangler you’re becoming >;)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Rethinking:[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Waifu Pass[/b]. The revamp is due for a revamp! It’s all gotta change – the rewards, the tiers, the requirements! Might be an autumnal update at the latest.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Main story delivery[/b]. The Waifu Shop story is currently divided into chapters, which are divided amongst your Workers. Adventurers get sex scenes, Workers get [i]everything[/i]. We want to let Harmony and your Waifu Shop Worker gang [i]shine even brighter[/i].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Daily tasks.[/b] We’re running a whole different game to what we had in October 2024. Therefore, we gotta create a whole different set of daily tasks to match the new gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549806/44a508305f7aca7b9c2109f373e23abfdc5ff07f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Conceptualizing (doable):[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Community features[/b] are the foundation of this season’s development. We’re currently busy with [b]leaderboards, [/b]the first of which has already been implemented into Bunny’s Lucky Run. But there is also…[/p][/*][*][p]…[b]visiting and voting [/b]for the best Shop. Jazz up your place and bring out the fine china, there’s guests coming over![/p][/*][*][p]Date night! A [b]chat system [/b](Scroll system? Parchment penpals??) lets you get intimate with your Waifu in a cozier, more personalized environment. An environment to solicit some nudes, respectfully.[/p][/*][*][p]New options to [b]unlock Exotic Waifu [/b]outside of Gacha Pulls (via new event types and such).[/p][/*][*][p]Rizz up your Worker Waifu – [b]high charisma[/b] [b]speeds up crafting[/b]![/p][/*][*][p]The hips don’t have to do all the talking – we can also do [b]a localization [/b]sometime.[/p][/*][*][p]Deeper [b]item and skill progression [/b]systems will make your Waifu better prepared for [i]The Next Chapter.[/i][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]The Next Chapter[/b][/h2][list][*][p]We’re thinking about [b]combat[/b]. It’s not on our calendar yet, but combat multiplayer is the next big thing, right after we polish the community features mentioned above.[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]multiplayer system [/b]lets us continue working on ideas from [url="https://tendertroupe.com/waifu-shop-roadmap/"]our original Roadmap[/url], though they might be presented differently than what we originally thought they would be. Kaiju battles whennnn??[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549806/d0e8d227932563cad90b121c6de1bc3f1e9110e2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Closing thoughts[/b][/h1][p]What a wonderful community Waifu Shop has brought together! It is a gratifying thing for a developer to work on their project with such creative input from the players – makes us feel like we’re doing a good thing together. Our gratitude goes to our [url="https://discord.gg/ugHkRpaFPt"]Discord community [/url]and our most diligent mods![/p][p]If you didn’t know, we’ve just finished our first Community Waifu Voting, and there’s an Art Contest going on. The community voted for their own waifu concept – an Old Ones faction Mystic Sea Witch. Animal-like (specifically a wild, aquatic mammal with predator traits), with dark fantasy-toned hair, a soft & round body, and flirty & seductive personality. It took some weird turns but she’s looking kinda cute now. We can’t wait to see your interpretations of her![/p][p]Thank you for staying with us for our second big Roadmap, and remember to
[b]CRAFT. TRADE. LOVE.[/b][/p][p][i]– The Waifu Shop Development Team[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549806/8d35899948ff54f0eba7637d39608403844d2123.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Elven Splendor Waifu Pass
notes.content:
[p]We humans have always looked at the Elves from a distance,
envious of their beautiful world and their long lives.[/p][p][/p][p]But you too can radiate with their their ethereal style, Master Trader!
With the [b]Elven Splendor Waifu Pass[/b], our Elven Waifu will feel right at home
in your Shop and in your arms.[/p][p][/p][p]Be enchanting.[/p][p] -------------------------------------------------------------[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549806/73f7fb5d020b7d57ff4a35af9cf409adae69f1c5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]With a new Waifu Pass comes [b]a new Exotic Waifu[/b]!
Meet [b]the Scavenger[/b]:[/p][p][/p][p]The sun warming her cheeks, a stream to cool her toes, sleeping under a starry night.
Runa doesn't ask for a lot, just GOOD COMPANY to share a drink with.[/p][p][/p][p]You'll have some difficulty peddling your wares at this crafty bohemian
but she could be convinced to stop by the Shop in different ways!  [/p][p][/p][h2](GOODCOMPANY is also a code you can redeem in the game for extra crystals) [/h2][p][/p][p][i]Runa is available in Exotic Pulls from July 1st to 15th.[/i][/p][p][/p][p] -------------------------------------------------------------[/p][p][/p][p]These additions are part of the Waifu Shop update. Any players who had issues collecting Leaderboard Rewards from last week's Lucky Run will be able to collect them as soon as they update their game.
Congrats! Bunny will see you again. :3 [/p][p][/p][p]CRAFT. TRADE. LOVE.[/p]

notes.title: BIG UPDATE + BUG FIX
notes.content:
[p]There was a pretty nasty bug the past few days that affected quite a few games, and we now have  a fix live. If you've been experiencing an invisible shop, infinite currencies that you cannot use, and menus that aren't interactable, please update your game and put these troubles behind you. 😊[/p][p][/p][p]The new update also comes with [i]some nifty features.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Waifu Shop now has a [b]Shard Exchange Shop[/b]! Check under your Shop menu to turn in your dupes for new rewards - including Shard Dust exclusive new character, Celia![/p][/*][*][p]All [b]duplicate shards[/b] will now be automatically turned to [b]Shard Dust[/b].,[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Check your craftable items again! The recipes now have [i]lore[/i].,[/p][/*][*][p]As mentioned above - [b]Invisible Shops invisible no more[/b]! If your game has been buggy recently, it'll work fine again when you next launch it.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you are having trouble updating (though the game should auto-update as soon as you start it), try this:
Right-click on Waifu Shop in your Steam Library menu > Properties > Installed Files > Verify integrity of game files. That'll sort you out for sure![/p]
